name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
summary:
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell ( MOO-kar-sell; born January 18, 1971) is an American politician and academic administrator serving as the Executive Director of the Graduate School of Political Management at George Washington University since 2025. A member of the Democratic Party, she served as the U.S. representative for Florida's 26th congressional district from 2019 to 2021. 
Born in Ecuador, Mucarsel-Powell made history as the first Ecuadorian-American and first South American-born immigrant to serve as a member of the U.S. Congress.
